t: You're looking at 56 Artillery Lane in Spitalfields, an eighteenth-century Grade I listed building on Artillery Passage. After the Second World War it was merged with number 58 next door, and together they have one of the oldest shop fronts in London. Today the combined building is Raven Row, a free art exhibition centre. The architect was Sir Robert Taylor, who was both an architect and a sculptor and worked in London and the south of England.
